description: D-01-ext Exa verification — remaining 15 vehicles × 3 fields
prompt_improvements_over_v1: Added special-case handling for Tesla Model Y Juniper (NA specs emerging)
Added explicit reminder that MSRPs stay Low even when confirmed
Added `proposed_value` field to schema (v1 had it implicit)

value_corrections.reason: InsideEVs EPA 300 mi = 483 km; seed was from earlier MY

quality_notes: Most vehicles agreed within ±2%. Mach-E ER AWD caught a real EPA bump (467→483). Tesla Model Y Juniper remains sparse (Canadian availability unclear). One subagent misread: IONIQ 5 AWD showed range 290 which was 290 MILES (467 km); I spotted this in review and skipped that proposal.
improvements_for_next_run: Require all Exa numbers to be given in both units (miles AND km) to catch unit errors at source
Check if vehicle has sibling entries (RWD vs AWD) — share specs that should match (battery kWh, chemistry)
Build a per-vehicle `charging_curve` verifier next — Fastned stats can confirm kW-vs-SoC curves
